item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We must stop its development—not slow it down, not regulate it after release, but prevent it from being built.

2. We reject the idea that any company, government, or laboratory has the right to gamble with every human life. Building superintelligence with current techniques will kill us all. It must be prohibited worldwide.

3. We cannot “win” a race to superintelligence. If anyone reaches the finish line using anything like current methods, humanity dies. We are calling for an immediate halt and enforceable international rules to stop anyone from building it.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 111 words

We need to say this without euphemism: if anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are not describing a distant possibility or a problem that can be managed after deployment. A system more capable than humanity, built through methods we do not understand or control, will escape our safeguards and end human life. No company, government, or research lab has the right to take that risk on behalf of eight billion people. We therefore call for an immediate halt to efforts aimed at creating superintelligence and for enforceable international rules that prevent anyone, anywhere, from building it. Our survival must come before technological ambition.
